create_column_text_view: create a ColumnTextView with a ColumnTextModel to render two-column text overlays in MuJoCo
render_mujoco_depth_buffer: render the MuJoCo scene depth buffer as a subsampled RGB image in the viewport
add_view_to_layout: add a BaseViewportView instance to a ViewportLayout at a specific PanelLocation
remove_view_from_layout: remove a view from a ViewportLayout or clear all views using the clear method
define_panel_location: define a PanelLocation enum value to position overlay views in the MuJoCo render window
